page.layout: One text block, a single verse set in interlinear form: Latin line, Samaritan Hebrew line, then italic transliteration, repeated down the page. Above the block, a title line with the page number "(38)" at the very top. Below the block, at the right, the catchword "Intro-". No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Ex Deuteron. Cap. I. ver. I.
Mofeh eft locutus quæ verba: Ifta [illegible,
~30 letters] Mofe dibber afcher haddevarim Elle
Jarden tranfitu in Ifrael omnem ad [illegible,
~30 letters] hajarden beaver Ifrael col el
inter ,Suph contra planitie in deserto in [illegible, ~30

page.notes: The Samaritan-script lines (after "Ifta", "omnem ad", "deserto in", "Paran" and "Chatferoth &") are too small to read letter by letter, so each is marked illegible with an estimated letter count. The Latin and the transliteration lines are read directly from the scan. The transliteration "Ifta" line ends in the printed word "Elle" and is kept as printed. The title line "Ex Deuteron." has the printed abbreviation kept, and "Cap. I. ver. I." is kept as printed.
